== Card Text ==
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここを支配していれば、フォース消耗に＋１。デス・スターに捕まっているキャラクターは、すべて解放される。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' The printed text box is blank.<ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
No lore is printed on this card.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' Death Star: Detention Block Control Room.

'''Light Side:''' If you control here, add 1 to the Force drain. All characters held prisoner on the Death Star are released.

'''Dark Side:''' The printed text box is blank.
